main_measure.name: t of the slope of the coin-demeaned 28-bar forward return on the forecast, pooled over coins, non-overlapping grid, non-zero forecast bars
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 with at least 50 grid cases (and timing gain > 0) confirms; t <= -2 with at least 50 grid cases rejects

supporting_check.name: timing gain: book mean daily return minus position held x coin's mean daily return

decided_by: The slope's t is between -2 and 2 with at least 50 grid cases.
reading: Profile bars are those whose recorded regime is 'unknown' (the only regime with a strategy) and the expected side is the sign of the raw centred multiple; the coin's mean 28-bar return is taken on all its windows' non-overlapping grid bars, the regression has an intercept, and the timing gain uses daily returns of postRebalance_total_value with the previous day's postRebalance_current_allocation for the market part.
